rows.jyutping: A ge3 sam1 han2 sau2 laat6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to refer to a person's ruthless nature or conduct as a noun.

example.english: He will do anything to snatch customers, which really shows his ruthlessness.
example.traditional: 佢為咗搶客乜都做得出，真係睇得出佢嘅心狠手辣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 coeng2 haak3 mat1 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1 zan1 hai6 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 ge3 sam1 han2 sau2 laat6
